_comment: Hand-checked prerequisites. Fields here replace what scrape.py parsed. 'why' explains the correction.

COMP_ENG 358-0.text: Prerequisite: (CS 213 or (CE 205 & 211)) or MS CS/CE or PhDs CS/CE or permission of Instructor.
COMP_ENG 358-0.why: Catalog uses abbreviations: '(CS 213 or (CE 205 & 211))'. There is no COMP_ENG 211; 211 is COMP_SCI 211-0.

notes: GEN_ENG 231-0 prerequisite is from the EE degree page footnote, not the course entry
ELEC_ENG 302-0.why: Course entry only lists a MATH 228-2 corequisite; the EE degree page says GEN_ENG 231-0 is required first.

COMP_SCI 180-0.text: Prerequisites: GEN_ENG 150-0 or GEN_ENG 151-0 or COMP_SCI 150 or COMP_SCI 1CA. Students cannot concurrently be enrolled in COMP_SCI 208_0 or COMP_SCI 211_0.
COMP_SCI 180-0.why: Keeps the AP-credit option, which isn't a course on the map.

COMP_SCI 208-0.text: Prerequisites: COMP_SCI 150 or GEN_ENG 150 or GEN_ENG 151 and COMP_SCI 180. Students cannot concurrently be enrolled in COMP_SCI 211-0 or COMP_SCI 180_0.
COMP_SCI 208-0.why: 'A or B or C and D': the intro course (any of three) and COMP_SCI 180.

COMP_SCI 301-0.text: Prerequisites: COMP_SCI 110-0 , COMP_SCI 111-0 , COMP_SCI 150, GEN_ENG 150-0 , GEN_ENG 151-0 , MECH_ENG 224-0 , or consent of instructor.
COMP_SCI 301-0.why: Comma list ending in 'or consent': any one of the six.

COMP_SCI 302-0.why: Graduate option kept as a note.

notes: the COMP_SCI 150 / GEN_ENG 150 / 151 option is for cognitive science majors
